scripts.build: bun run build:node && bun run build:cli
scripts.build:judge: cargo build --locked -p ytm-node -p ytm-cli --features ytm-node/judge-fixtures,ytm-cli/judge-fixtures && node packages/node/scripts/build.mjs
scripts.validate: bun run contracts:check && bun run licenses:check && bun run release:check && bun run validate:node
scripts.test:surfaces: bun run build:judge && bun run judge
scripts.contracts:check: node scripts/validate-contracts.mjs && node scripts/generate-native-packages.mjs --check && bun run rust:fixture-guard
scripts.smoke:cli: cargo run --locked -p ytm-cli -- matrix --base-date 2026-06-08 --kind 국채 --format json
